article.story: BOWLING GREEN, Ky. -- — Ryan Myers' 19 points helped Western Kentucky defeat NAIA member Campbellsville 102-59 on Monday night. Myers also had eight rebounds for the Hilltoppers (7-3). Armelo Boone totaled 18 points and eight rebounds. Louie Semona hit four 3-pointers and scored 16. Ra Briggs finished with 11 points for the Tigers. Dalton Kramer added nine points. Western Kentucky took the lead for good with 14:01 left in the first half. The score was 54-28 at halftime, with Myers racking up 14 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
